title: Rackspace Spot breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Rackspace, Platform9, BleepingComputer, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Rackspace Spot runs customers' Kubernetes clusters, and the admin console was down for days. Rackspace reportedly says some customer organizations were affected. The number is unknown.
who_is_affected: Organizations that run workloads on Rackspace Spot. Rackspace says Spot shuts down Dec 8, 2026 at 5pm CT; customers need to retrieve data and move workloads before then, and rotate Spot API tokens, refresh tokens, kubeconfigs and cluster Secrets.

known.text: Rackspace's Spot status page refers to 'the recent security incident affecting Rackspace Spot'.
Rackspace says it will wind down Spot on Dec 8, 2026 at 5pm CT; running workloads will be terminated and data will not be accessible after that date.
Rackspace's release notes list a November 2026 fix that closed a network exposure on Spot worker nodes as part of security hardening.
Rackspace's Spot status page said new sign-ups were restricted until Nov 25, 17:00 UTC after recent system maintenance.

not_known.text: Whether Rackspace will confirm on its own pages how the security incident happened. The details (leaked credentials, Nov 17) come from a customer notice and a Spot team member's forum post.
Whether customer data or Secrets were actually read or misused, not just readable.
Whose credential was used, how it leaked, what the breached observability system is, and who used it.
Whether the full restoration Nov 21 is confirmed by Rackspace on its own pages.
